about: Register a child at a licensed nursery in Abu Dhabi.
note: Requirements read from the official ADEK nursery registration requirements page on the checked date. Registration is done directly at the nursery, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: The child must be no older than 4 years
documents: Registration form with the child's name, nationality, date of birth, enrolment date, home address and phone numbers
Copy of the child's Emirates ID
Copy of the child's birth certificate
Any other documents the nursery asks for
The original Emirates ID must be shown at registration
fees: Each nursery sets its own fees within the law; fee increases need ADEK approval
timing: Registration follows the nursery's own admission process, with no step at ADEK
